name: Cinema Studio
summary: Pick a camera body, lens, focal length and aperture; they become part of the prompt.

source.notes: Camera and lens vocabulary from open-higgsfield-ai (MIT), src/lib/promptUtils.js. Camera, lens and focal options write the look they give, not the gear: with "shot on a <camera>" Z-Image drew the camera into the picture (run 20261020-133620-l40s), and "no camera in the frame" did not stop it (run 20261024-172353-h100). Since 25 Oct the still is drawn by FLUX 3 Image Klein (16:9, 1344x768) instead of Z-Image Turbo, without the prompt upsampler: the app writes the whole prompt.

inputs.label: Scene
inputs.default: A detective in a trench coat lights a cigarette under a streetlamp on a rainy night

bind.template: A cinematic film still: {prompt}. The look: {camera}; {lens}; {focal}; {aperture}. Cinematic lighting, natural color science, high dynamic range, ultra-detailed
